one_line: Global AI investment is projected to reach USD 1.4 trillion in 2027 while infrastructure growth sparks hardware price hikes and political opposition.

themes.title: Nvidia and China chip sales scrutinized
themes.text: Singapore prosecutors charged Li Ming with fraud regarding restricted AI chip shipments to China through Megaspeed, while U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated Jensen Huang's potential return as Nvidia CEO should await probes into the company's China sales.

stories.headline: Chinese national Li Ming charged in fraud case linked to Megaspeed
Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang's Nvidia return should await China probes
Li Ming central to smuggling restricted AI chips from Southeast Asia to China

themes.title: AI infrastructure spending and supply pressures
themes.text: UBS projects global AI investment will reach USD 1.4 trillion in 2027, as server suppliers raise prices by up to 45 percent and officials warn of infrastructure upgrade outages.

stories.headline: UBS projects global AI investment to reach USD 1.4 trillion in 2027
AI server suppliers demand higher prices after contracts signed
Data centers emerge as a political flashpoint amid growing tech backlash
Officials warn of more tech outages during AI infrastructure upgrades

themes.title: OpenAI proposes perplexity safety metric
themes.text: OpenAI published internal perplexity measurements for models from GPT-3.5 onward, proposing the metric for industry safety standards.

stories.headline: OpenAI shares internal perplexity data and proposes shared AI safety limits

themes.title: Anthropic valuation and Tesla FSD updates
themes.text: Anthropic surpassed a USD 1 trillion valuation as CEO Dario Amodei promotes his philosophy, and Tesla rolled out FSD v15 ahead of a wide release.

stories.headline: Anthropic valued at over $1 trillion as CEO Dario Amodei shares philosophy
Tesla rolls out FSD v15 with real-time AI rendering and December wide release
